# Adapt To Life

> Adapt To Life is a Chicago-area adaptive sports nonprofit, a 501(c)(3) (EIN 41-3213344). We expand access to adaptive sports so athletes can find their place. We fund and support athletes and the programs they play in; clubs and partners host and run the play. Adaptive Sports Near Me (https://adaptivesportsnearme.com), our free directory for finding a place to play, is in beta now: beta testers are using it before it opens to everyone.

Our blog shares what it takes to build adaptive sports, in public: the people, the tournaments, what things cost, and what we learn.

## Key pages

- [Adapt To Life](https://adapttolife.org/): Chicago adaptive sports nonprofit. We expand access to adaptive sports so athletes can find their place.
- [Hustle & Heart Fund](https://adapttolife.org/hustle-and-heart): Our athlete fund: equipment, training and travel for adaptive athletes. It works through ambassadors, and any athlete can apply.
- [Chicago Pickleball: Wheelie Big Dills](https://adapttolife.org/pickleball): The wheelchair pickleball crew Adapt To Life funds and supports.
- [The Road to the US Open](https://adapttolife.org/road): A season of tournament travel for the crew, ending at the US Open, where players are picked by lottery.
- [The numbers](https://adapttolife.org/numbers): Our goal for the year ahead and what each part pays for.
- [Donate](https://adapttolife.org/donate): Give to the Hustle & Heart Fund. Donations are tax deductible to the extent allowed by law.
- [Partners](https://adapttolife.org/sponsorship): Our partner clubs and nonprofits, and how sponsorship works.
- [Ambassadors](https://adapttolife.org/ambassadors): Athletes, coaches and community connectors who tell the fund where it will do the most.
- [Events](https://adapttolife.org/events): Tournaments and fundraisers, upcoming and past.
- [Apply for support](https://adapttolife.org/apply): How athletes apply to the Hustle & Heart Fund.
- [About](https://adapttolife.org/about): The people behind Adapt To Life, and why.
- [Adaptive Sports Near Me](https://adapttolife.org/adaptive-sports-near-me): Our free directory of adaptive sports programs, grants and events, at adaptivesportsnearme.com. It is in beta now: beta testers are using it before it opens to everyone.

## Blog

- [Blog](https://adapttolife.org/blog): Stories, tournament recaps, guides and the numbers. RSS: https://adapttolife.org/blog/feed.xml

### Stories

- [Juan Ortiz](https://adapttolife.org/juan): Paralyzed at 14, Hall of Famer in wheelchair softball, dad of three, and Adapt To Life’s first ambassador.
- [Karen Atkinson](https://adapttolife.org/karen): A retired Army captain who golfs standing up, skis, sails and dives, and serves on our board.
- [Tim Gruensfelder](https://adapttolife.org/tim): The wheelchair basketball athlete whose love of the game lives on through the Hustle & Heart Fund.

### On the road

- [Monster Smash 2026: Six Wheelchair Pickleball Medals in Cincinnati](https://adapttolife.org/events/monster-smash-2026): A Halloween tournament weekend at The Pickle Lodge in Cincinnati. The host made it free for wheelchair athletes, and the athletes we support came home with six medals.
- [The APP Tour's First Wheelchair Division, Vlasic Classic Chicago 2026](https://adapttolife.org/events/app-vlasic-classic-2026): Juan Ortiz asked the APP Tour for a wheelchair division in Highland Park. Five full teams played the APP’s first.

### Guides

- [How Much Does a Sport Wheelchair Cost? $4,000 to $6,000](https://adapttolife.org/sport-wheelchair-cost): A sport wheelchair runs $4,000 to $6,000, and insurance doesn’t cover it.
- [Sponsor Adaptive Athletes in Chicago](https://adapttolife.org/sponsor-adaptive-athletes): What sponsoring a wheelchair pickleball athlete pays for, and what a sponsor gets back.
- [Corporate Matching Gifts: Double Your Gift to Adapt To Life](https://adapttolife.org/corporate-matching): Many employers match gifts to 501(c)(3) nonprofits. How to get yours matched, with our legal name, EIN and IRS letter.

### Building in public

- [The numbers](https://adapttolife.org/numbers): Every number in our goal for the year ahead, and what each one pays for.
